column4: Help customers find the right product quickly from the supermarket's catalogue.
Let customers collect items, apply offers and pay securely online.
Let customers choose when the order arrives and follow it until it reaches them.
Give customers a secure account and make repeat ordering effortless.

column3: Register / log in with mobile OTP
column4:
As a new or returning shopper, I want to register and log in using my mobile number and a one-time password (OTP), so that my cart and orders are saved to my account.

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: Log in with a correct OTP
Given I am a guest with items in my cart and I enter a valid 10-digit mobile number
When I request an OTP and enter the 6-digit code correctly within 5 minutes
Then I am logged in (an account is created if this is my first time) and my guest cart is merged into my account

Scenario (negative): Wrong OTP (negative)
Given I have requested an OTP
When I enter an incorrect code
Then I see 'Incorrect OTP, 2 attempts left' and after 3 wrong attempts I am blocked from retrying for 15 minutes

Scenario (negative): Expired OTP (negative)
Given I received an OTP more than 5 minutes ago
When I enter that OTP
Then I see 'This OTP has expired' and I am offered a 'Resend OTP' button

As a shopper, I want to search for products by name or keyword, so that I can find the groceries I need quickly.

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: Successful search by name
Given I am on the home screen and the catalogue contains 'Basmati Rice 5 kg'
When I type 'basmati' in the search bar and tap Search
Then the results list shows every product whose name contains 'basmati' and each result shows its image, name and price and the results appear within 2 seconds

Scenario (negative): No matching products (negative)
Given no product in the catalogue matches 'xyzabc'
When I search for 'xyzabc'
Then I see the message "No products found for 'xyzabc'" and I am offered links to browse by category and no error screen is shown

Scenario (negative): Empty search input (negative)
Given the search bar is empty
When I tap Search
Then no search is run and I see the prompt 'Enter at least 2 characters'
As a shopper, I want to view a product's details (images, price, unit/weight, nutrition and stock status), so that I can decide whether to buy it.

As a shopper, I want to add products to a cart and change or remove quantities, so that I can review my basket before paying.

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: Add an item to the cart
Given 'Toned Milk 1 L' is in stock and priced at ₹60 and my cart is empty
When I tap 'Add to cart' on that product
Then the cart badge shows 1 item and the cart subtotal shows ₹60

Scenario: Change quantity
Given my cart contains 2 × 'Toned Milk 1 L' at ₹60 each
When I increase the quantity to 3
Then the line total shows ₹180 and the cart subtotal is recalculated

Scenario (negative): Quantity above available stock (negative)
Given only 4 units of 'Toned Milk 1 L' are in stock and I already have 4 in my cart
When I try to increase the quantity to 5
Then the quantity stays at 4 and I see the message 'Only 4 left in stock'

Scenario: Remove the last item
Given my cart contains exactly one item
When I remove that item
Then the item disappears and I see 'Your cart is empty' with a link back to the catalogue

As a shopper, I want to select my delivery address and an available delivery time slot at checkout, so that my groceries arrive when I am at home.

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: Select an available slot
Given I am at checkout with an address inside the serviceable area
When I open delivery slots and select 'Tomorrow, 6 PM to 8 PM'
Then the slot is highlighted and it appears in my order summary and the slot is held for me for 10 minutes

Scenario (negative): Slot is full (negative)
Given the 'Tomorrow, 6 PM to 8 PM' slot has reached its capacity of 20 orders
When I view the delivery slots
Then that slot is shown as 'Full' and it cannot be selected

Scenario (negative): Address outside delivery area (negative)
Given I enter a pincode that is not serviced by any store
When I tap Continue
Then I see 'Sorry, we don't deliver to this pincode yet' and no slots are shown and I cannot proceed to payment

As a shopper, I want to pay for my order online using UPI or a debit/credit card, so that I can complete my purchase without handling cash.

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: Successful UPI payment
Given my cart total is ₹850 and I have selected a delivery address and slot
When I choose UPI and approve the payment in my UPI app
Then the order is created with status 'Confirmed' and I see a confirmation screen with the order ID and a receipt is sent by SMS

Scenario (negative): Card payment declined (negative)
Given I have chosen to pay by card and my bank declines the transaction
When the payment result is returned to the app
Then I see 'Payment failed, no amount has been charged' and no order is created and my cart is kept and I can retry or choose another method

Scenario (negative): Payment not completed in time (negative)
Given I started a UPI payment and did not approve it
When 5 minutes pass
Then the payment attempt expires and the reserved stock and slot are released and I am told the order was not placed
As a shopper, I want to filter search results by category, price range and dietary type (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free), so that I only see products that suit me.
As a shopper, I want to see my delivery partner's live location on a map once my order is out for delivery, so that I know when to expect it.
As a shopper, I want to receive push or SMS notifications when my order is confirmed, packed, out for delivery and delivered, so that I stay informed without opening the app.
As a shopper, I want to apply a valid promo code to my cart, so that I get the discount that was offered to me.
As a returning shopper, I want to view my past orders and reorder them with one tap, so that I can repeat my regular shopping quickly.
As a shopper, I want to schedule a recurring weekly order, so that my regular staples are delivered automatically.
